```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  # add 2 to i
  j <- i + 2
  # take the square root of j
  sj <- sqrt(j)
  # round sj to the nearest whole number
  rsj <- round(sj)
  # print rsj
  print(rsj)
}
```

```{r}
library(cowsay)
species <- c("frog", "stegosaurus", "squirrel", "ghost")

for (spp in species) {
  say(paste("I am a", spp), by = spp)
}
```

```{r}
species <- c("monkey", "shark", "turkey", "snowman")

for (spp in species) {
  has_s <- startsWith(spp, "s")
  say(paste("Do I start with an s?", has_s), by = spp)
}
```

```{r}
cubed_nums <- c()

for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  res <- i^3
  cubed_nums <- c(cubed_nums, res)
}

print(cubed_nums)
```

```{r}
species <- c("monkey", "shark", "turkey", "snowman")
species_df <- tibble()

for (spp in species) {
  has_s <- startsWith(spp, "s")
  current_row <- tibble(
    Species = spp,
    Starts_with_S = has_s
  )
  species_df <- species_df |> bind_rows(current_row)
}
gt(species_df)
```

```{r}
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
print(sample(breakfast, size = 1))
```

```{r}
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
ran_num <- seq_len(5)

break_df <- tibble()

for (i in seq_len(10))
{item <- sample(breakfast, size = 1)
number <- sample(ran_num, size = 1)
row <- tibble(item = item, count = number)
break_df <- bind_rows(break_df, row)}
gt(break_df)
```
